content.short: UniVoucher enables on-chain crypto gift cards that anyone can create, send, and redeem.
content.description: UniVoucher is a decentralized protocol that lets anyone create, send, and redeem crypto gift cards on-chain using a card ID and secret, similar to traditional gift cards. Unlike custodial systems that hold funds in their own wallets, UniVoucher is non-custodial, global, and permissionless, and it supports any token in any amount. People can use UniVoucher to gift crypto to friends, sell cards in local stores for cash, or integrate it into digital shops and dApps as a simple value-transfer tool.
